# Copilot instructions

See [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root for authoritative
guidance on this repository's structure, package contract, conventions, and
traps. Subpackages under `python/btap/` (e.g. `modeling/`, `codes/`,
`audit/`) each carry their own `CLAUDE.md` with domain-specific notes — read
the one nearest the code you are changing in addition to the root file.
